_comment: Every weapon has exactly 3 slots. Weapon identity = which 3 slot types + banned tags + banned media + base stats. Ban lists stay short by rule; the Stapler is the one whitelist, because it is the one weapon outside the ink economy.

weapons.name: Biro
weapons.note: Takes everything. Deliberately the most combinable weapon in the game.

weapons.name: Fineliner
weapons.role: Precision rifle. Draws one long exact line.
weapons.note: A shaky hand ruins a fine line. Bans SPRAY and CHAOS outright.

weapons.name: Brush
weapons.note: Cannot mount a scope. No slot for one, and it bans PRECISION anyway.

weapons.name: Marker
weapons.note: Marker-medium parts bleed their tags into adjacent slots. Your parts interact whether you wanted them to or not.

weapons.name: Spraycan
weapons.note: Nothing about this is precise and nothing about it penetrates.

weapons.name: Eraser
weapons.role: Short cone. Low lethality; strips enemy parts.
weapons.note: Has no MUZZLE slot because it does not shoot. It un-draws. The comeback tool.

weapons.name: Stapler
weapons.role: Nailgun. Scarce map-found staples, not ink.
weapons.note: Only STAPLE-medium parts. Sits entirely outside the ink economy — every part on it has draw 0.

weapons.name: Highlighter
weapons.role: Support beam. Marks enemies, boosts allied ink gain.
weapons.note: Cannot land a killing blow — only brings an enemy to 1 HP.
